response.original_title: Nako 一番星が眩しくて・星なこ
response.overview: The star of this production is none other than "STAR CHILD" herself—Nako Hoshi! With her radiant, fair skin, firm F-cup bust, a lively personality, and a bright, beaming smile, she is a true beauty. She has recently chopped off her long hair, giving her an even fresher, more vibrant look. In this, her first "image video" (gravure-style shoot), she reveals a surprising, intense side—distinct from her usual style—and she embraces it with such a positive, enthusiastic attitude that it makes the experience all the more exciting! She’s also incredibly accommodating, answering even the risqué questions in her interview with a sweet voice and complete, candid openness. Her favorite outfit is a sheer, see-through babydoll—she loves how cute it looks, and she’s eager for you to see it! With her cheerful, sunny disposition, this beloved star is destined to shine brighter than anyone else—a true "first star" in the night sky!
